note: Which sheet a figure draws at an angle off the line to the camera (0 faces the camera, 90 faces screen right, 180 turns its back): the table the renderer (ui/tests/directionalWalkSector.test.ts) and the script check (tests/test_series_directional.py) both assert, so the two cannot drift apart. `walking` is for a figure that faces where it goes: the larger part of its movement decides, and only a walk within 12 degrees of the diagonal is three-quarter (walkDiagonalDeg of app/shared/directional_sprites.json). `standing` is the equal 45 degree sectors. A negative angle is the same sector seen from the left.
